mechanics: Pay anywhere: at least 8 matching symbols, without adjacency or paylines. Do not describe this as cluster pays.
After a win, paid symbols disappear and replacements fall into the gaps; tumbles continue until no more combinations win.
Multiplier symbols range from 2x to 500x; their values add and apply to the sequence's total win at its end.
Four or more scatters start 15 free spins. During free spins, multipliers landing on winning tumbles add to a running bonus total.
